purpose: Record source-level dependence at the corpus/subcorpus level so digital overlap cannot be misrepresented as independent verification.

depends_on: Brixhe-Lejeune 1984 CIPPh unless specifically indicated otherwise
lineages.evidence: TITUS source introduction explicitly states that absent special indication its text follows Brixhe/Lejeune 1984.

lineages.rule: TM identity metadata may strengthen identity/provenance/date fields when actually retrieved, but does not independently verify the reading inherited by UD.

lineages.evidence: Public dissertation repository states that a catalogue of all known Phrygian inscriptions was compiled before lexical analysis.

period_boundaries.Old: keep source sigla/provenance and Phrygian-script editorial conventions
period_boundaries.Middle: retain explicit source classification and ambiguity; do not infer solely from date/script
period_boundaries.New: keep numeric catalogue traditions and Greek-script source representation distinct from Old Phrygian
period_boundaries.Mysian: comparison/quarantine unless independently admitted as Phrygian

canonical_promotion_rule: Two digital representations sharing an edition lineage count as one reading lineage. Canonical promotion requires an admissible source-level witness and explicit project reconciliation.
